_comment: Base Object Swapper (BOS, D-6). Emits <file>_SWAP.ini at the mod root — replaces a base object with another when a reference loads, no ESP override = zero conflict. MVP = the [Forms] section. Requires po3_BaseObjectSwapper.dll at runtime; BOS resolves form refs against the player's load order (ModForge only checks structure).
